items.evidence: Atomic owner-only JSON; configurable retention/disable saving. A dedicated serial writer coalesces edits, flushes on orderly quit, preserves unreadable files until explicit reset and confirms history before releasing recording recovery. items.gap: History is not application-encrypted; use FileVault. Launch loading/search indexing remain work. An abrupt crash can lose an unflushed edit inside the 300 ms debounce window. Abrupt active capture can leave private temporary audio; no secure-erasure claim.
